column1: # Fixed-partition spec shared by every ESP32-S3 board. cmake/gen-partitions.cmake keeps only the
# fixed rows below and (re)generates `factory` (sized to fill the flash
# size) and `storage` (the embedded source FAT image) per build. The factory line here is just the
# fallback size used if a build ever omits the flash size; it is set small so it fits even a 4 MB
# board. Only the fixed partitions are below.
